title: Who Gets the Backup
about: Scenes for the Story-Fabric-SDWAN_Zones fabric. Two broadband circuits in one SD-WAN zone, cellular in its own zone. Staff may use cellular; guests may not (firewall policy), so when both broadband circuits fail, staff stay online and guests go dark on purpose. Cables are named 'Device:port' exactly as Fabric Studio shows them. Only cables listed here can ever be broken or repaired by story-runner.

users.name: Corp_User
users.label: Staff
users.rule: Broadband 1, then Broadband 2, then cellular as a last resort.

users.name: Guest_User
users.label: Guests
users.rule: Broadband 2, then Broadband 1. Never cellular: the firewall policy doesn't allow it.

scenes.title: Cut Broadband 1
scenes.blurb: A backhoe finds the fiber. The FortiGate's WAN1 port goes dark.
scenes.expect: Staff move to Broadband 2 and share it with the guests. Nobody notices.

scenes.title: Cut Broadband 2
scenes.blurb: The second provider's handoff fails. WAN2 goes dark.
scenes.expect: Guests move over to Broadband 1. Staff never left it.

scenes.title: Lose both broadband circuits
scenes.blurb: A storm takes out both providers at once. Only cellular is left.
scenes.expect: Staff move to cellular and keep working. Guests go dark, on purpose: policy keeps them off the metered link.

scenes.title: Broadband 1 provider outage
scenes.blurb: The cable is fine and the modem lights are green, but the provider's core is down. Only the SLA probes notice.
scenes.expect: Staff move to Broadband 2 as soon as the probes fail, even though WAN1 still has link.

scenes.title: Both broadband providers down upstream
scenes.blurb: Both ports stay up, both modems look healthy, and neither goes anywhere.
scenes.expect: Same outcome as losing both circuits, found by the probes alone: staff on cellular, guests dark.

scenes.title: Cut the cellular link
scenes.blurb: The cellular modem dies on a normal day.
scenes.expect: Nothing visible changes. Cellular was idle, standing by.
